★ HOW TO PLAY
Everyone sits in a circle with a wrapped gift. The reader reads a story aloud. When you hear LEFT or RIGHT, pass your gift in that direction. ACROSS means swap with the player across from you, and CENTER means hold your gift up high. When the story ends, you keep the gift in your hands.
